title: Attested, Not Exhaustive: data and code
description: Data, code and results for the paper Attested, Not Exhaustive: Constructing and Evaluating Benchmarks for Literary Intertextuality Detection (Computational Humanities Research Conference 2027). Three commentary-derived golds of scholar-attested intertextual relations (Russian poetry; Crime and Punishment against the 1823 New Testament; Dante and the Duecento), the retrieval probes and experiments, the result tables the paper's numbers are read from, and scripts that reproduce them.
